title: A love that won't be stopped
titleHi: ऐसा प्यार जो रोके भी नहीं रुकता
scope: Participles: imperfective and perfective participles as adjectives, agreeing, with optional हुआ for an ongoing or completed state (रोती हुई लड़की, टूटा हुआ प्याला); state vs event (टूटी हुई थी / टूट गई थी); adverbial participles in invariable -e (हँसते हुए, लिए हुए); repeated participles for repeated or parallel action (चलते चलते); गिरते गिरते बचना; -ते समय, -ते ही (possessed: माँ के आते ही); time since an event (गए हुए एक घंटा हुआ) and since a situation began (रहते हुए एक साल हुआ); बिना + -e; possessed participles (माँ का बनाया, आपके रहते, मेरे उठाए भी … नहीं उठा); intransitive and transitive pairs (बचना/बचाना, सोना/सुलाना, मरना/मारना, लदना/लादना, दिखना/दिखाना, खाना/खिलाना, टूटना/तोड़ना/तुड़ाना); causatives in -vā- with से for the agent

vocab.en: to make go round, show round

items.q: Fill the gap: “A broken cup had been put on the table.”
items.hi: मेज़ पर एक ___ हुआ प्याला रखा था ।
items.say: मेज़ पर एक टूटा हुआ प्याला रखा था ।
items.en: A[2] broken[3+4] cup[5] {had been put}[6+7] on[1] the table[0].
wrong: टूटी
टूटी is feminine. प्याला is masculine.
टूटे
टूटे is plural or oblique. प्याला is a direct singular subject.
टूटाई
Not a word. The participle of टूटना is टूटा, टूटी, टूटे.
items.why: Used as an adjective, a participle (imperfective बीतता, perfective बीता) agrees with its noun. हुआ, agreeing too, can be added to stress an ongoing or a completed state (रोती हुई लड़की, टूटा हुआ प्याला).

items.q: Fill the gap: “The girl sitting by the window is my sister.”
items.hi: खिड़की के पास ___ हुई लड़की मेरी बहिन है ।
items.say: खिड़की के पास बैठी हुई लड़की मेरी बहिन है ।
items.en: The girl[5] sitting[3+4] by[1+2] the window[0] is[8] my[6] sister[7].
wrong: बैठा
बैठा is masculine. It agrees with लड़की.
बैठे
बैठे is masculine plural or oblique. लड़की is feminine.
items.why: Used as an adjective, a participle (imperfective बीतता, perfective बीता) agrees with its noun. हुआ, agreeing too, can be added to stress an ongoing or a completed state (रोती हुई लड़की, टूटा हुआ प्याला).

items.q: Fill the gap: “We helped a man who had fallen in the road.”
items.hi: हमने सड़क पर एक ___ हुए आदमी की मदद की ।
items.say: हमने सड़क पर एक गिरे हुए आदमी की मदद की ।
items.en: We[0] helped[7+8+9] a[3] man[6] who had fallen[4+5] in the road[1+2].
wrong: गिरा
Before की the phrase is oblique — गिरे हुए आदमी की.
गिरी
गिरी is feminine. आदमी is masculine.
items.why: Used as an adjective, a participle (imperfective बीतता, perfective बीता) agrees with its noun. हुआ, agreeing too, can be added to stress an ongoing or a completed state (रोती हुई लड़की, टूटा हुआ प्याला).

items.q: Fill the gap: “Raj was standing holding a book in his hand.”
items.hi: राज हाथ में किताब ___ हुए खड़ा था ।
items.say: राज हाथ में किताब लिए हुए खड़ा था ।
items.en: Raj[0] {was standing}[6+7] holding[4+5] a book[3] in[2] his hand[1].
wrong: लिया
Used as an adverb, the participle is invariable in -e — लिए हुए.
लेता
लेता is the imperfective. “Holding” is the state after taking: लिए हुए.
items.why: Used as an adverb, the participle (+ हुए) has the invariable -e ending (हँसते हुए, पकड़े हुए, लिए हुए).

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: मैंने उसे गाना गाते हुए सुना ।
items.a: I heard her singing a song.
wrong: She heard me singing a song.
मैंने is the hearer, उसे the singer.
I asked her to sing a song.
सुना is “heard”, and गाते हुए “singing”.
items.why: With verbs of seeing and hearing, the participle describes the person seen or heard.

items.q: Fill the gap: “Sita came home singing.”
items.hi: सीता गाते ___ घर आई ।
items.say: सीता गाते हुए घर आई ।
items.en: Sita[0] came[4] home[3] singing[1+2].
wrong: हुआ
गाते is the -e form, used as an adverb, so हुए follows — गाते हुए.
हुई
With गाती, हुई would match (गाती हुई). With गाते it is गाते हुए.
हुआए
Not a word. The form is हुए.
items.why: Used as an adverb, the participle (+ हुए) has the invariable -e ending (हँसते हुए, पकड़े हुए, लिए हुए).

items.q: Fill the gap: “This kurta is hand-made.”
items.hi: यह कुरता हाथ से ___ हुआ है ।
items.say: यह कुरता हाथ से बना हुआ है ।
items.en: This[0] kurta[1] is[6] hand-made[2+3+4+5].
wrong: बनी
बनी is feminine. कुरता is masculine.
बने
बने is plural. It is one kurta.
items.why: Used as an adjective, a participle (imperfective बीतता, perfective बीता) agrees with its noun. हुआ, agreeing too, can be added to stress an ongoing or a completed state (रोती हुई लड़की, टूटा हुआ प्याला).

items.q: Which sentence describes a state: “the window was broken (and still was)”?
wrong: खिड़की टूट गई थी ।
This describes the event: “the window had broken”.
खिड़की तोड़ी गई थी ।
This is the passive: “the window had been broken (by someone)”.
items.why: A perfective participle with हुआ describes a state resulting from an earlier action: खिड़की टूटी हुई थी “was broken” (state), but खिड़की टूट गई थी “had broken” (event).
items.say: खिड़की टूटी हुई थी ।
items.en: The window[0] was[3] broken[1+2].

items.q: Fill the gap: “Whose is the car standing outside?”
items.hi: बाहर ___ हुई गाड़ी किसकी है ?
items.say: बाहर खड़ी हुई गाड़ी किसकी है ?
items.en: Whose[4] is[5] the car[3] standing[1+2] outside[0]?
wrong: खड़ा
खड़ा is masculine. गाड़ी is feminine.
खड़े
खड़े is masculine plural or oblique. गाड़ी is feminine.
items.why: खड़ा “standing” is an adjective, but behaves like बैठा and पड़ा and can take हुआ. Used as an adjective, a participle (imperfective बीतता, perfective बीता) agrees with its noun. हुआ, agreeing too, can be added to stress an ongoing or a completed state (रोती हुई लड़की, टूटा हुआ प्याला).

items.q: Fill the gap: “Writing letters all day long, my hand got tired.”
items.hi: सारा दिन चिट्ठियाँ लिखते ___ मेरा हाथ थक गया ।
items.say: सारा दिन चिट्ठियाँ लिखते लिखते मेरा हाथ थक गया ।
items.en: Writing[3+4] letters[2] all[0] day[1] long, my[5] hand[6] {got tired}[7+8].
wrong: लिखता
The repeated participle is invariable in -e — लिखते लिखते.
लिखना
The repetition uses the participle, not the infinitive — लिखते लिखते.
items.why: A repeated imperfective participle in -e, without हुए, shows an action repeated over time or running alongside the main verb (चलते चलते थक गए).

items.q: Fill the gap: “On your way to the office, bring milk from the market.”
items.hi: दफ़्तर जाते ___ बाज़ार से दूध ले आना ।
items.say: दफ़्तर जाते समय बाज़ार से दूध ले आना ।
items.en: {On your way}[1+2] to the office[0], {bring}[6+7] milk[5] from the market[3+4].
wrong: ही
जाते ही is “as soon as you go”. “On your way” is जाते समय.
बाद
“After” would be जाने के बाद, with the oblique infinitive.
items.why: Imperfective participle in -e + समय or वक़्त means “at the time of doing, while doing”.

items.q: Fill the gap: “As soon as I got off the bus, I phoned you.”
items.hi: बस से उतरते ___ मैंने तुम्हें फ़ोन किया ।
items.say: बस से उतरते ही मैंने तुम्हें फ़ोन किया ।
items.en: {As soon as}[3] I[4] got off[2] the bus[0+1], I phoned[6+7] you[5].
wrong: समय
उतरते समय is “while getting off”. “As soon as” is उतरते ही.
भी
भी is “also, even”. “As soon as” is उतरते ही.
items.why: Imperfective participle in -e + ही means “as soon as”. With two different subjects, the participle may be “possessed” with का (माँ के आते ही).

items.q: Fill the gap: “As soon as Mother came, the children sat down to eat.”
items.hi: माँ ___ आते ही बच्चे खाना खाने बैठ गए ।
items.say: माँ के आते ही बच्चे खाना खाने बैठ गए ।
items.en: {As soon as}[1+3] Mother[0] came[2], the children[4] {sat down}[7+8] to eat[5+6].
wrong: का
The participle आते is in -e, so the possessive is oblique — माँ के आते ही.
को
With two subjects the participle is “possessed” — माँ के आते ही.
items.why: Imperfective participle in -e + ही means “as soon as”. With two different subjects, the participle may be “possessed” with का (माँ के आते ही).

items.q: Fill the gap: “The car narrowly missed hitting a tree.”
items.hi: गाड़ी पेड़ से टकराते टकराते ___ ।
items.say: गाड़ी पेड़ से टकराते टकराते बची ।
items.en: The car[0] {narrowly missed}[5] hitting[2+3+4] a tree[1].
wrong: बचा
बचा is masculine. गाड़ी is feminine.
बचाई
बचाना is transitive, “to save (something)”. The car escaped — बची.
items.why: A repeated imperfective participle in -e followed by बचना describes a narrow escape (गिरते गिरते बचा “nearly fell”).

items.q: Fill the gap: “Don't touch my things without asking.”
items.hi: बिना ___ मेरी चीज़ें मत छुओ ।
items.say: बिना पूछे मेरी चीज़ें मत छुओ ।
items.en: Don't[4] touch[5] my[2] things[3] without[0] asking[1].
wrong: पूछा
बिना takes the perfective participle in -e — बिना पूछे.
पूछना
बिना takes the perfective participle in -e, not the infinitive.
items.why: बिना + perfective participle in -e means “without doing” (बिना पूछे, बिना सोचे). The order खाए बिना is also used.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: रेडियो सुनते सुनते दादा जी सो गए ।
items.a: Grandpa fell asleep listening to the radio.
wrong: Grandpa went to sleep and then listened to the radio.
सुनते सुनते runs alongside: he was listening when he fell asleep.
Grandpa listens to the radio every night before sleeping.
सो गए is a single past event.
items.why: A repeated imperfective participle in -e, without हुए, shows an action repeated over time or running alongside the main verb (चलते चलते थक गए).

items.q: Which means “without thinking”?
wrong: बिना सोचा
बिना takes the perfective participle in -e — सोचे.
सोचते समय
सोचते समय is “while thinking”.
items.why: बिना + perfective participle in -e means “without doing” (बिना पूछे, बिना सोचे). The order खाए बिना is also used.

items.q: Fill the gap: “Don't talk while eating.”
items.hi: खाना खाते ___ बात मत करो ।
items.say: खाना खाते समय बात मत करो ।
items.en: Don't[4] talk[3+5] while[2] eating[0+1].
wrong: ही
खाते ही is “as soon as you eat”.
बिना
बिना takes the perfective participle — बिना खाए “without eating”.
items.why: Imperfective participle in -e + समय or वक़्त means “at the time of doing, while doing”.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: मेरी बात सुनते ही वह हँस पड़ा ।
items.a: As soon as he heard what I said, he burst out laughing.
wrong: He laughed all the time I was talking.
सुनते ही is “as soon as he heard”.
He laughed before he heard what I said.
सुनते ही is “immediately on hearing”.
items.why: Imperfective participle in -e + ही means “as soon as”. With two different subjects, the participle may be “possessed” with का (माँ के आते ही).

items.q: Fill the gap: “It's an hour since Raj went.”
items.hi: राज को गए हुए एक घंटा हो ___ ।
items.say: राज को गए हुए एक घंटा हो गया ।
items.en: It's[6+7] an[4] hour[5] since Raj[0+1] went[2+3].
wrong: गए
गए is plural. The time, एक घंटा, is the subject — singular.
गई
गई is feminine. घंटा is masculine.
items.why: Time since a completed event: perfective participle (+ हुए) with the time as subject (उसे गए दो घंटे हो गए). Time since a current situation began: imperfective participle + हुए (यहाँ रहते हुए दो साल हुए).

items.q: Fill the gap: “Sita has been working here for six months.”
items.hi: सीता को यहाँ काम ___ हुए छह महीने हो गए हैं ।
items.say: सीता को यहाँ काम करते हुए छह महीने हो गए हैं ।
items.en: Sita[0+1] {has been working}[3+4+5+8+9+10] here[2] for six[6] months[7].
wrong: किए
किए हुए would be time since a completed event. She is still working — करते हुए.
करती
In this construction the participle is in -e — करते हुए.
items.why: Time since a completed event: perfective participle (+ हुए) with the time as subject (उसे गए दो घंटे हो गए). Time since a current situation began: imperfective participle + हुए (यहाँ रहते हुए दो साल हुए).

items.q: Fill the gap: “The food Mother makes is the best.”
items.hi: माँ का ___ खाना सबसे अच्छा होता है ।
items.say: माँ का बनाया खाना सबसे अच्छा होता है ।
items.en: The food[3] Mother[0+1] makes[2] is[7] the best[4+5+6].
wrong: बनाई
बनाई is feminine. खाना is masculine.
बनाता
The possessed participle here is perfective — माँ का बनाया खाना.
items.why: Participles can be “possessed” like nouns: माँ का बनाया खाना “food made by Mother”, आपके रहते “while you're here”. A possessed transitive with an intransitive shows a failed attempt (मेरे उठाए भी वह नहीं उठा).

items.q: Fill the gap: “While you're around, we have no worries about anything.”
items.hi: आपके ___ हमें किसी बात की चिंता नहीं ।
items.say: आपके रहते हमें किसी बात की चिंता नहीं ।
items.en: While[1] you're[0] around[1], we[2] {have no}[7] worries[6] about anything[3+4+5].
wrong: रहे
रहे is perfective. “While you're around” uses the imperfective — आपके रहते.
रहना
The possessed form uses the participle — आपके रहते.
items.why: Participles can be “possessed” like nouns: माँ का बनाया खाना “food made by Mother”, आपके रहते “while you're here”. A possessed transitive with an intransitive shows a failed attempt (मेरे उठाए भी वह नहीं उठा).

items.q: Fill the gap: “Despite my trying to get him up, he didn't get up.”
items.hi: मेरे ___ भी वह नहीं उठा ।
items.say: मेरे उठाए भी वह नहीं उठा ।
items.en: {Despite my trying}[0+1+2] to get him up, he[3] {didn't}[4] {get up}[5].
wrong: उठाया
The possessed participle in this construction is in -e — मेरे उठाए.
उठे
उठना is intransitive. The trying is transitive — उठाना, मेरे उठाए.
items.why: Participles can be “possessed” like nouns: माँ का बनाया खाना “food made by Mother”, आपके रहते “while you're here”. A possessed transitive with an intransitive shows a failed attempt (मेरे उठाए भी वह नहीं उठा).

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: उसे गए हुए दस मिनट भी नहीं हुए थे कि वह लौट आया ।
items.a: He'd been gone barely ten minutes when he came back.
wrong: He came back after ten minutes and left again.
गए हुए … नहीं हुए थे — ten minutes hadn't even passed since he left.
He left ten minutes after coming back.
The order is the other way round: he left, and soon came back.
items.why: Time since a completed event: perfective participle (+ हुए) with the time as subject (उसे गए दो घंटे हो गए). Time since a current situation began: imperfective participle + हुए (यहाँ रहते हुए दो साल हुए).

items.q: Which means “I've been waiting for an hour”?
items.a: मुझे इंतज़ार करते हुए एक घंटा हो गया है ।
wrong: मुझे इंतज़ार किए हुए एक घंटा हो गया है ।
किए हुए measures time since a finished act, not a wait still going on.
मैंने एक घंटे इंतज़ार किया ।
This is “I waited for an hour”, and the wait is over.
items.why: Time since a completed event: perfective participle (+ हुए) with the time as subject (उसे गए दो घंटे हो गए). Time since a current situation began: imperfective participle + हुए (यहाँ रहते हुए दो साल हुए).
items.say: मुझे इंतज़ार करते हुए एक घंटा हो गया है ।
items.en: I[0] {have been waiting}[1+2+3+6+7+8] for an[4] hour[5].

items.q: Which is the transitive partner of पहुँचना “to arrive”?
wrong: बचाना
बचाना “to save” pairs with बचना “to escape”.
समझाना
समझाना “to explain” pairs with समझना “to understand”.
items.why: Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: Fill the gap: “The police saved the child from the river.”
items.hi: पुलिस ने बच्चे को नदी से ___ ।
items.say: पुलिस ने बच्चे को नदी से बचाया ।
items.en: The police[0+1] saved[6] the child[2+3] from[5] the river[4].
wrong: बचा
बचना is intransitive, “to escape”. With ने the transitive बचाना is needed.
बचाई
With को on the object the verb is masculine singular — बचाया.
items.why: Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: Fill the gap: “Mother put the child to sleep.”
items.hi: माँ ने बच्चे को ___ दिया ।
items.say: माँ ने बच्चे को सुला दिया ।
items.en: Mother[0+1] {put}[4+5] the child[2+3] {to sleep}[4].
wrong: सो
सोना is intransitive. “Put to sleep” is सुलाना.
सोने
सोने दिया is “let (the child) sleep”. “Put to sleep” is सुला दिया.
सोवाया
Not a word. The transitive of सोना is सुलाना.
items.why: Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: Fill the gap: “Sita served the guests food.”
items.hi: सीता ने मेहमानों को खाना ___ ।
items.say: सीता ने मेहमानों को खाना खिलाया ।
items.en: Sita[0+1] served[5] the guests[2+3] food[4].
wrong: खाया
खाया is “ate”. “Served, fed” is खिलाया.
खिलाई
खिलाई is feminine. खाना is masculine.
items.why: Some transitives have a second transitive: खाना “to eat”, खिलाना “to serve, feed”. Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: Fill the gap: “He showed me his new car.”
items.hi: उसने मुझे अपनी नई गाड़ी ___ ।
items.say: उसने मुझे अपनी नई गाड़ी दिखाई ।
items.en: He[0] showed[5] me[1] his[2] new[3] car[4].
wrong: दिखी
दिखना is intransitive, “to appear”. With ने the transitive दिखाना is needed.
दिखाया
दिखाया is masculine. With ने the verb agrees with गाड़ी, feminine.
items.why: Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: मरना “to die” → मारना “to kill”. How is the transitive formed?
items.a: by lengthening the vowel of the first syllable
wrong: by adding -ā to the stem
That is the pattern of बचना → बचाना.
by adding -vā- to the stem
-vā- makes a causative (बनवाना).
items.why: Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: Fill the gap: “The children are flying kites outside.”
items.hi: बच्चे बाहर पतंग ___ रहे हैं ।
items.say: बच्चे बाहर पतंग उड़ा रहे हैं ।
items.en: The children[0] {are flying}[3+4+5] kites[2] outside[1].
wrong: उड़
उड़ना is intransitive: the kites would be flying by themselves.
उड़ते
उड़ते is the participle. The continuous uses the stem — उड़ा रहे हैं.
उड़ावा
Not a word. The transitive of उड़ना is उड़ाना.
items.why: Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: Fill the gap: “All the luggage got loaded onto the cart.”
items.hi: गाड़ी पर सारा सामान ___ गया ।
items.say: गाड़ी पर सारा सामान लद गया ।
items.en: All[2] the luggage[3] {got loaded}[4+5] onto[1] the cart[0].
wrong: लाद
लादना is transitive. “Got loaded” is the intransitive लदना — लद गया.
लादना
The compound verb needs the stem of लदना — लद गया.
items.why: Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: मुझे यह सवाल समझाओ ।
wrong: I understand this question.
समझाना is “to explain”. “Understand” is समझना.
Ask me this question.
“Ask” would be पूछना.
items.why: Transitive verbs are often made from intransitives by lengthening the stem (बचना → बचाना, सोना → सुलाना) or the first syllable (मरना → मारना, कटना → काटना).

items.q: Which verb means “to have (something) broken”?
wrong: तोड़ना
तोड़ना is “to break (something)”.
टूटना
टूटना is “to be broken, break”.
items.why: Some verbs form a three-way series: intransitive टूटना, transitive तोड़ना, and a second transitive तुड़ाना.

items.q: Fill the gap: “Father is having the car repaired by the mechanic.”
items.hi: पिता जी मिस्त्री से गाड़ी ठीक ___ रहे हैं ।
items.say: पिता जी मिस्त्री से गाड़ी ठीक करवा रहे हैं ।
items.en: Father[0+1] {is having}[6+7+8] the car[4] repaired[5] by[3] the mechanic[2].
wrong: कर
ठीक कर रहे हैं is “is repairing (himself)”. The mechanic does it — करवा.
हो
ठीक हो रहे हैं is intransitive, “getting better”.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: Fill the gap: “She had this letter written by someone.”
items.hi: उसने यह चिट्ठी किसी से ___ ।
items.say: उसने यह चिट्ठी किसी से लिखवाई ।
items.en: She[0] had[5] this[1] letter[2] written[5] by someone[3+4].
wrong: लिखवाया
लिखवाया is masculine. With ने the verb agrees with चिट्ठी, feminine.
लिखी
लिखी is “wrote (herself)”. Someone else wrote it — लिखवाई.
लिखावाई
Not a word. The causative is लिखवाना, लिखवाई.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: Fill the gap: “I had my friend read this poem.”
items.hi: मैंने यह कविता अपने दोस्त ___ पढ़वाई ।
items.say: मैंने यह कविता अपने दोस्त से पढ़वाई ।
items.en: I[0] had[6] my[3] friend[4+5] read[6] this[1] poem[2].
wrong: ने
ने marks the main doer, मैंने. The one made to do it takes से.
का
का would make it “my friend's poem”. The person made to read takes से.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: Which verb means “to cause to be made”?
wrong: बनाना
बनाना is “to make”.
बनना
बनना is “to be made, come into being”.
बनावाया
Not a word. The causative is बनवाना.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: मैंने अपने कमरे की सफ़ाई करवाई ।
wrong: I cleaned my room.
करवाई is causative: someone else did the cleaning.
My room needs cleaning.
करवाई is a past act: the cleaning was done.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: Fill the gap: “Sita had all her clothes washed by the dhobi.”
items.hi: सीता ने अपने सारे कपड़े धोबी से ___ ।
items.say: सीता ने अपने सारे कपड़े धोबी से धुलवाए ।
items.en: Sita[0+1] had[7] all[3] her[2] clothes[4] washed[7] by[6] the dhobi[5].
wrong: धुलवाईं
धुलवाईं is feminine. कपड़े is masculine.
धोए
धोए is “washed (herself)”. The dhobi did it — धुलवाए.
धोलवाए
Not a word. The causative of धोना is धुलवाना.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: Fill the gap: “Have the gardener cut the grass in the garden.”
items.hi: माली से बग़ीचे की घास ___ दो ।
items.say: माली से बग़ीचे की घास कटवा दो ।
items.en: Have[5+6] the gardener[0+1] cut[5] the grass[4] in the garden[2+3].
wrong: काट
काट दो is “cut (it yourself)”. Getting the gardener to do it is कटवा दो.
कट
कटना is intransitive, “be cut”.
कटावा
Not a word. The causative is कटवाना.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: In a causative sentence, the person made to do the work takes …
wrong: ने
ने goes on the main doer in the perfective: मैंने … लिखवाई.
का
का makes a possessive. The person made to do the work takes से.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: राज ने अपना पुराना घर बेच दिया और नया बनवाया ।
items.a: Raj sold his old house and had a new one built.
wrong: Raj sold his old house and built a new one himself.
बनवाया is causative: someone else built it.
Raj's old house fell down and he built a new one.
बेच दिया is “sold”.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.en: There's[6] a[2] broken[3+4] chair[5] in[1] the room[0].
wrong: टूटा
टूटा is masculine. कुरसी is feminine.
टूटे
टूटे is plural or oblique. कुरसी is feminine.
टूटाई
Not a word. The participle is टूटी.

items.en: The children[0] came[4] home[3] laughing[1+2].
wrong: हँसता
As an adverb the participle is in -e — हँसते हुए.
हुआ
हँसते is the -e form, so हुए follows.

items.en: {As soon as}[3] I[0] reached[2] home[1], it began[6] to rain[4+5].
wrong: समय
पहुँचते समय is “while reaching”. “As soon as” is पहुँचते ही.
लगा
बारिश is feminine — लगी.
पहुँचतेते
Not a word. The participle is पहुँचते.

items.en: Don't[3] go[4] out[2] without[0] eating[1].
wrong: खाया
बिना takes the perfective participle in -e — खाए.
खाते
खाते is imperfective. “Without eating” is बिना खाए.

items.en: It's[5+6] six[3] months[4] since we[0] met[1+2].
wrong: मिलते
मिलते हुए is for a situation still going on. Time since the meeting is मिले हुए.
गया
गया is singular. छह महीने is plural — हो गए.

items.en: Mother[3] sings[5+6] songs[4] while[2] cooking[0+1].
wrong: बनाया
बनाते समय uses the imperfective participle in -e.
गाता
गाता is masculine. माँ takes गाती हैं.

items.en: I[0] had[5] my[1] brother[2+3] write[5] the letter[4].
wrong: लिखवाया
लिखवाया is masculine. With ने the verb agrees with चिट्ठी, feminine.
ने
The person made to write takes से. ने goes only on मैंने.
लिखावाई
Not a word. The causative is लिखवाई.

items.en: Father[0+1+2] {laid}[7+8] the child[3+4] {down}[7] on[6] the bed[5].
wrong: लेट
लेटना is intransitive, “to lie down”. Laying someone down is लिटाना.
दी
With को on the object the verb is masculine singular — दिया.

items.en: We[2] {got tired}[3+4] walking and walking[0+1].
wrong: चलता
The repeated participle is invariable in -e — चलते चलते.
गया
गया is singular. हम is plural — थक गए.
चलतेते
Not a word. The participle is चलते.

items.en: The man[4] standing[2+3] at[1] the door[0] is[6] a tailor[5].
wrong: खड़ी
खड़ी is feminine. आदमी is masculine.
खड़े
खड़े is plural or oblique. आदमी is a direct singular subject.

items.en: Sita[0+1] showed[5] me[2] a[3] picture[4].
wrong: दिखी
दिखना is intransitive, “to appear”. With ने the transitive दिखाना is needed.
दिखाया
तस्वीर is feminine — दिखाई.

items.en: Raj[0+1] explained[5] the whole[3] matter[4] to me[2].
wrong: समझी
समझना is “to understand”. “Explain” is the transitive समझाना.
समझाया
With ने the verb agrees with बात, feminine — समझाई.

lessons.title: What does it mean?
lessons.desc: Read a sentence, pick the translation

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: पुल पर खड़े हुए लोग नदी को देख रहे थे ।
items.a: The people standing on the bridge were looking at the river.
wrong: The people were standing up to look at the river.
खड़े हुए is “standing”, describing the people.
The people stood the bridge over the river.
खड़े हुए लोग is “people (who were) standing”.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: मुझे यहाँ आए हुए अभी एक ही हफ़्ता हुआ है ।
items.a: I've only been here a week.
wrong: I'll be here for only a week.
आए हुए … हुआ है is time since arrival, not a future plan.
I came here a week ago and then left.
The time is counted up to now: I'm still here.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: वह बिना बताए घर से चला गया ।
items.a: He left home without telling anyone.
wrong: He told everyone and left home.
बिना बताए is “without telling”.
He left home to tell someone.
बिना is “without”.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: उसने अपना सारा काम दूसरों से करवाया ।
items.a: He got others to do all his work.
wrong: He did all the others' work.
करवाया is causative, and दूसरों से are the ones who did it.
He did all his work with others.
करवाया is “had done”: he did none of it himself.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: बच्चा रोते रोते सो गया ।
items.a: The child cried himself to sleep.
wrong: The child woke up crying.
सो गया is “fell asleep”.
The child stopped crying and went to sleep.
रोते रोते is “while crying”: he was still crying.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: दरवाज़ा खुला हुआ था ।
wrong: Someone opened the door.
खुला हुआ था describes a state, not the act of opening.
The door was shut.
खुला is “open”.

items.q: What does this sentence mean?
items.hi: माँ ने बाज़ार से सब्ज़ी मँगवाई ।
items.a: Mother had vegetables fetched from the market.
wrong: Mother went to the market to buy vegetables.
मँगवाई is causative: someone else fetched them.
Mother sold vegetables at the market.
मँगवाना is “to order, have fetched”.

items.q: In जली हुई गाड़ी, what does हुई add?
wrong: It makes the phrase passive
The passive is participle + जाना.
It turns the phrase into a question
हुई confirms the state: “a burned car”.
items.why: Used as an adjective, a participle (imperfective बीतता, perfective बीता) agrees with its noun. हुआ, agreeing too, can be added to stress an ongoing or a completed state (रोती हुई लड़की, टूटा हुआ प्याला).

items.q: Used as an adverb (हँसते हुए, लिए हुए), the participle ends in …
wrong: -ī, always
-ī is feminine, used when the participle agrees as an adjective.
-ā, like the perfective
As an adverb the book's form is invariable -e.
items.why: Used as an adverb, the participle (+ हुए) has the invariable -e ending (हँसते हुए, पकड़े हुए, लिए हुए).

items.q: What does an imperfective participle + ही mean (आते ही)?
wrong: while, at the time of
That is the participle + समय or वक़्त.
without
“Without” is बिना + perfective participle in -e.
items.why: Imperfective participle in -e + ही means “as soon as”. With two different subjects, the participle may be “possessed” with का (माँ के आते ही).

items.q: To say “it's a year since he left”, Hindi uses …
items.a: the perfective participle, with the time as subject
wrong: the imperfective participle
The imperfective is for a situation still going on: रहते हुए एक साल हुआ.
the infinitive + से
That isn't how time since is shown in this unit.
items.why: Time since a completed event: perfective participle (+ हुए) with the time as subject (उसे गए दो घंटे हो गए). Time since a current situation began: imperfective participle + हुए (यहाँ रहते हुए दो साल हुए).

items.q: Causative verbs such as बनवाना and लिखवाना contain …
wrong: -ā- before -nā
That makes a transitive, such as बनाना.
a lengthened first syllable
That makes some transitives, such as मारना from मरना.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: In मैंने भाई से चिट्ठी लिखवाई, who wrote the letter?
wrong: I did
I had it written. भाई से marks the one who wrote it.
nobody: it's a request
लिखवाई is a past act: the letter was written.
items.why: Causative verbs in -vā- mean “to get something done (by someone)”: बनवाना, लिखवाना, करवाना. The person who does the work takes से.

items.q: What does मेरे उठाए भी वह नहीं उठा mean?
items.a: He didn't get up, though I tried to get him up
wrong: He didn't get up, so I didn't lift him
मेरे उठाए is “my getting (him) up”, a failed attempt.
I didn't get up when he tried to wake me
वह is the one who didn't get up.
items.why: Participles can be “possessed” like nouns: माँ का बनाया खाना “food made by Mother”, आपके रहते “while you're here”. A possessed transitive with an intransitive shows a failed attempt (मेरे उठाए भी वह नहीं उठा).
